turn.prompt: improve the app and detect waiting agents and show the questions, allow me to answer the qustions inline from the app
turn.headline: Theasa now detects waiting agents and answers their questions from the app.
summary: Theasa adds a live agent view that shows waiting agents and their questions. You can answer from the page.
The log shows a test answer sent from the page that reached the agent. A multi-line answer from the API was pasted but not submitted, and the log does not show a fix for that.
The test suite passes with 16 tests at the end of the turn. The log does not show a commit.
The Sidra port is not done. The log shows a briefing sent to another agent, and its result is not in the log.

steps.title: Route found
steps.text: herdr reports each agent state. herdr also sends keys and text to agent panes.

steps.title: Answer method tested
steps.text: Esc, then a prompt with the answers, made the test agent continue.

steps.title: Question not found
steps.text: The test agent shows as blocked, but Theasa does not find its question.

steps.title: Question hook added
steps.text: install.ts adds a PreToolUse hook for AskUserQuestion. The hook keeps the asked questions until the dialog closes.

steps.title: Multi-line answer not submitted
steps.text: The answer text reached the input box, but was not sent.

steps.title: Page answer works
steps.text: An answer sent from the page reaches the agent and the agent continues.

steps.title: Tests pass
steps.text: All 16 tests pass after the code changes.

steps.title: Sidra briefing
steps.text: The Sidra port is briefed to another agent. The port waits for this feature.

decisions.text: Capture pending questions with a Claude PreToolUse hook for AskUserQuestion.
decisions.why: The transcript did not show the question while the agent was blocked.
decisions.alternative: Read the question from the transcript file.

decisions.text: Answer a question by sending Esc, then a prompt with the answers.
decisions.why: The test showed that the agent continues after this sequence.

decisions.text: Do the Sidra port after the waiting-agents feature.
decisions.why: The port should include the feature.
